criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: Flat, seen from above, consistent with the floor plane. Minor: inner recess shading is inverted/uneven — the lid has a 2px black band on the south (rows 26-27) and east (cols 26-27) edges but only 1px on north/west (row 5, col 4); with v5's top-left light the frame should shade the north/west inner edge, not south/east.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Frame stone ramp (B/N/D/C) fits v5. Lid is built almost entirely from near-black values (19,19,23)/(30,30,36)/(42,42,50); the advertised two-tone slab and corner seams (K vs Q) are ~12 levels apart and vanish at 1x, so the lid reads as a flat black void/hole rather than dressed stone. Busy: grey ring circle + rune dots + two straps + star + pull ring all inside a 22x22 lid.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: At 1x in the archive it reads as a dark plaque with a star; the trapdoor cue is weak. The hinge straps are 10px long (rows 4-13, cols 8-9 and 22-23) and their tips diagonally touch the star's arm tips at (9,13)-(10,14) and (22,13)-(21,14), so at 1x/3x they read as two chains hanging the star from the top edge, not as hinges. Pull ring (rows 22-25, cols 13-19) does read.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Flush with floor, no floating. Transparent margin is asymmetric: rows 0-1 empty at top vs only row 31 at bottom (cols 0/31 empty both sides), so the slab sits 1px low in its 2x2 cell.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Outer outline clean, no stray pixels outside the frame. Tangency between strap tips and star arms (see 3) is the main contour defect.

items.name: 별 봉인 돌뚜껑(닫힘, 2×2) (star seal)
reasons: Hinge straps (cols 8-9 and 22-23) run from row 4 to row 13 and their tips touch the star arms diagonally at (9,13)/(10,14) and (22,13)/(21,14); they read as chains suspending the star. Fix: end each strap at row 9 with a 1px point at row 10 (≈5px onto the lid), drop the rivet at row 10, keep ≥2px lid gap to the star arms and the grey ring.

Lid values too dark to show the two-tone stone and slab seams. Fix: raise the lid ramp ~+18 (Q (30,30,36)->~(48,48,58), K (42,42,50)->~(62,62,74), M ring ->~(100,100,116)), keep F (19,19,23) only as the 1px lid outline/seam lines so the corner slabs read at 1x.

Recess shading inverted: 2px black on south (rows 26-27) and east (cols 26-27) vs 1px north (row 5) / west (col 4). Fix: make north/west the 2px shadow band and south/east 1px (or equal 1px all round).
Asymmetric transparent margin (2px top, 1px bottom). Fix: shift the whole slab up 1px, or add one transparent row at the bottom by trimming one frame row, so it centres in the 2x2 cell.
Declutter: with straps shortened, either remove the grey ring circle (rows 7-22) or thin the rune dots to 4 at the diagonals so the star keyhole and pull ring are the two readable reads.
